name: candidate-v3-adaptive-controller-static
instruction: Controller cues (details remain in the four Skills): At the first Energy decision of each quarter, if a verifiable Planning checkpoint for this quarter is missing, re-read skills/rolling-planning/SKILL.md through the available Skill/file tool and rebuild the checkpoint from a fresh public observe before choosing Energy; reuse it for the same-quarter main action unless material feedback or public state changes. Re-read and rebuild after semiannual feedback, a severe public warning/consequence, continuation/context loss, or any missing, stale, or unverifiable checkpoint. Maintain one public-evidence-based Primary Gap; compare reliable recent observed effects ahead of advertised menu effects. Mark STALLED only after the same strategic action for the same gap has no observed progress at two adjacent comparable checkpoints; then compare a different-type legal alternative. One no-progress checkpoint does not force a switch, and STALLED does not force choosing the alternative. Track Risk Budget as TIGHT for fresh material risk, AVAILABLE only with no fresh material warning and visible relevant safety margin, otherwise UNKNOWN; safety is a constraint, and ordinary soft cost alone neither vetoes high-upside growth nor triggers RECONSIDER. Use only the public current month and 48-month horizon; never use evaluator weights or hidden thresholds. For ordinary non-strategic story choices, compare at most the two strongest legal candidates once; reopen only on fresh public evidence or risk-review=RECONSIDER. The Single Agent remains the sole action submitter.
